findings.summary: DeltaMem's ScienceWorld memory-mode ablation has an exact pre-paper public implementation bridge, but it is not fixed-bank + same-selected-identity + receiver-effect-only: task_only and env_only render different retrieved components and the historical ablation runner does not freeze PRTree updates.

DeltaMem's ablation source existed before paper submission, but raw result/trajectory Git absence cannot be used as non-execution evidence because ablation results, trajectories and storage/output forms were intentionally ignored; exact per-episode run provenance remains unresolved.
DeltaMem Frozen versus Unfrozen is an update-policy intervention, not a receiver gate: only Frozen keeps the warm-start bank immutable, while Unfrozen allows condition-dependent memory evolution.

SpeedRunner's current public allow_replay switch changes the induction prompt/tool contract as well as transactional commit/revert, so Figure 12 must not be promoted from replay-verification evidence to a proposal-frozen admission-only matched intervention using current code alone.

SpeedRunner's public ScienceWorld replay config first appears in the root initial-public-release commit after the paper submission and no current GitHub release/raw Figure-12 transaction bundle was located; historical evaluated revision and candidate/replay transaction provenance remain unresolved.

MemCompiler's current ScienceWorld evaluation harness was added after the paper chronology, points at ignored external DB/output paths and defaults to UPDATE_MEMORY=True; it therefore cannot by itself bind Table-3's evaluated memory bank/candidate pool/run identity or justify retroactive attribution of current defaults.

Official live reproduction paths inspected here require local environment/model provisioning and external model credentials in relevant configs, so they are not accepted Phase-1 zero-dependency routes; the source/provenance audit itself remains zero-incremental-cost and quota-independent.

protocol_change_rationale: No new validator was added. Existing fixed-selected receiver-effect, evaluation-memory-snapshot, evaluated-run-source and replay-export/coverage protocols already fail closed on the newly observed confounds. This checkpoint strengthens source-level scope boundaries rather than multiplying schemas.

scope_guard.deltamem: Treat Table-3 task-only/env-only as component evidence only. Same initial memory path is not same immutable bank, same selected record, or same receiver effect.
scope_guard.speedrunner: Treat replay as transactional admission evidence, not an admission-only causal intervention, unless a historical matched bundle fixes candidate bytes/proposal state and changes only post-proposal replay acceptance.
scope_guard.memcompiler: Treat paper Table-3 AMMI as same-candidate-pool evidence only. Do not infer evaluated run settings from the post-paper current evaluation script.

blockers: No public DeltaMem per-episode raw memory-mode bundle was recovered that freezes both bank state and selected identity across arms.
SpeedRunner Task-3 Figure-12 raw numeric series, exact candidate skill bytes, replay inputs/transcripts and commit/revert records remain unlocated.
MemCompiler Table-3 evaluated ScienceWorld memory database, ordered candidate pool, selected persistent record identities and exact evaluated run/source manifest remain unlocated.
The strongest desired science-domain intervention — fixed bank + same selected persistent record + same state/guidance + receiver effect only — remains unresolved.
